name: AIJ UWE benchmark — cleaned data API
description: Static JSON/CSV/STL endpoints for the Architectural Institute of Japan Urban Wind Environment benchmark (Cases A-E) and Eddy3D's validation against it. Every file is a plain HTTP GET; nothing is computed on request.
fallback_note: the same files, served raw from the repository's main branch (use when the Pages site is not reachable)

endpoints.description: every endpoint, versions, licence, how to cite
the five cases: id, title, configuration facts, units, frame, counts, engine status, links
one case in full: configurations, inflow fit and approach-flow profile, point-table summary, geometry files, validation status, gotchas
the cleaned measurement table, SI units, one frame, null for unmeasured
geometry description: frame, configurations, box lists where the geometry is boxes, STL statistics
cleaned ASCII STL of the default configuration, metres, outward normals
the other configurations' STLs (C: 0D, 1D; E: bc)
Eddy3D validation scores per engine (empty list where none has been run) with figure URLs
every STL of every case in one list: case, configuration, units, frame, bounding box, triangles, sha256, URL
every STL in one archive (each file stays in its own case's frame and units: they are not one scene)

licence_detail.note: The measurement data belongs to its collectors and distributors, named per case. Cite the AIJ UWE benchmark and the accompanying papers when using it.

cite.benchmark: Kikumoto, H., Okaze, T., Yoshie, R., Tachibana, T., Ishihara, T., Nonomura, Y., Kiyota, N., Kondo, H., Mochida, A., Tominaga, Y. (2026). Comprehensive Experimental Database for Validating CFD Simulations in Urban Wind Environment: Benchmark Cases Curated by the Architectural Institute of Japan. Japan Architectural Review 9(1), e70083. https://doi.org/10.1002/2475-8876.70083
cite.guidelines: Tominaga, Y., Mochida, A., Yoshie, R., Kataoka, H., Nozu, T., Yoshikawa, M., Shirasawa, T. (2008). AIJ guidelines for practical applications of CFD to pedestrian wind environment around buildings. J. Wind Eng. Ind. Aerodyn. 96, 1749-1761. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jweia.2008.02.058
cite.per_case: Each case lists its own data collectors, Zenodo DOI and requested citation.

walk: GET cases.json and pick an id
GET cases/{id}.json for frame, units and gotchas
GET cases/{id}/points.json (SI units, one frame) and cases/{id}/geometry.stl (metres)
GET cases/{id}/validation.json before quoting any Eddy3D score; an empty results list means no validation exists
